violations.description: The link text 'Accessibility Statement' is descriptive, but the multiple links to 'Privacy Policy' and 'Terms of Service' in both the modal and the footer are acceptable. However, the link text '#' used for 'Security', 'Roadmap', 'About', etc., in the footer is technically descriptive, but the link text '×' in the modal close button is ambiguous for users who cannot see the visual context, though it has an aria-label. There are no 'click here' or 'read more' links present.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: Text blocks in the hero section and feature cards lack a max-width constraint, potentially exceeding 80 characters per line on large viewports. Additionally, the default line-height is not explicitly set to 1.5 or higher for body text.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page does not provide a mechanism for the user to select foreground and background colors.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The toast notification system (toast-region) is designed to inject content into an aria-live region automatically. At the AAA level, interruptions such as notifications must be able to be postponed or suppressed by the user, except in emergencies.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: While the form provides basic hints for email and password, it lacks comprehensive context-sensitive help for complex fields like 'Company Size' or specific 'Terms of Service' implications, which is required for AAA compliance to assist users in completing tasks.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The form inputs (input[type='email'], input[type='text'], input[type='password'], select) have 'outline: none' applied in the :focus-visible state. While they change border-color, the removal of the default focus outline without a sufficiently thick (2px) and high-contrast replacement fails the Focus Appearance (Enhanced) requirements at the AAA level.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The 'Get Started' button text in the pricing section is used for multiple plans (Starter, Professional) and does not provide enough context on its own to distinguish which plan is being selected without reading the surrounding content.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text in the hero section and feature descriptions does not meet the minimum line-height requirement of 1.5. The 'text-gray-700' and 'text-xl' classes in this context typically default to a line-height of 1.25 or 1.375 (leading-tight/snug) in many utility frameworks, which is less than the 1.5 required for AAA.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The text blocks in the hero section and feature descriptions lack a max-width constraint that ensures lines do not exceed 80 characters. On large viewports, the text 'Connect all your data sources instantly...' will stretch across the container, exceeding the 80-character limit.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page does not provide a mechanism (e.g., a theme switcher or settings menu) to allow users to change foreground and background colors, which is a requirement for AAA compliance when not provided by the user agent.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The 'Sign Up' button and pricing plan 'Get Started' buttons lack context-sensitive help or instructions. For a complex data integration service, users may require help or documentation links to understand the implications of plan choices or sign-up requirements at the point of interaction.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The toast notification region (aria-live='polite') is present, but there is no mechanism provided in the HTML to postpone or suppress these interruptions. At the AAA level, users must be able to postpone or suppress interruptions except those involving an emergency.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The focus indicator for several interactive elements (links, buttons, and inputs) relies on the default browser outline which is often less than 2px thick. WCAG 2.2 AAA requires a minimum area equivalent to a 2px thick perimeter of the unfocused element.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The toast notification container is fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport. At the AAA level, no part of a focused element may be obscured. If a focusable element (such as a footer link) is positioned behind the toast container, it would be obscured when focused.

violations.description: The focus indicator for the .sort-button elements uses a 2px outline, which fails the AAA requirement for a 2px thick perimeter of the unfocused element. violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The focus indicator for .btn-details and .btn-secondary uses a 2px outline. For WCAG 2.2 AAA, the focus indicator must have an area at least as large as a 2px thick perimeter. While 2px is the thickness, any rounding or specific rendering that reduces the area below the mathematical 2px perimeter threshold would fail this strict AAA requirement.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The transaction details dialog contains several data fields (Customer, Product, Amount, Date, Status) but lacks context-sensitive help or instructions to assist users in understanding the data or the 'Export as PDF' action.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The CSS explicitly removes the default focus indicator using 'outline: none' for button and a elements without providing an immediate fallback for the :focus state. While :focus-visible is defined, users navigating with certain assistive technologies or older browsers that do not support :focus-visible will have no visible focus indicator.

violations.impact: moderate

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The link text 'Learn More' is ambiguous when taken out of context. While it has an aria-label, Success Criterion 2.4.9 (AAA) requires the link text itself (or its programmatic association) to be descriptive enough to identify the purpose without needing additional context.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The abbreviations 'SSO', 'GDPR', and 'HIPAA' are used without a mechanism for identifying their expanded forms (e.g., <abbr title='...'>) on their first occurrence.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The main content and testimonial text blocks lack a max-width constraint, allowing lines to exceed 80 characters on large viewports. Additionally, the default line-height for body text is not explicitly set to 1.5 or higher in the provided styles.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: There is no mechanism provided within the page to allow users to customize foreground and background colors.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The pricing plan selection and sign-up buttons trigger modals for complex processes (Sign Up/Contact Sales) without providing context-sensitive help, instructions, or links to documentation to assist users in completing the task.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The navigation bar is defined as 'sticky-top' (position: sticky). At the AAA level, no part of a focused element can be obscured. When a user navigates via keyboard to elements further down the page, the sticky header can overlap and completely or partially obscure the focused element.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The focus indicator for '.btn-outline-light' (white border) against the hero background (linear-gradient starting at #667eea) may not meet the 3:1 contrast ratio requirement against the adjacent background colors, especially as the gradient shifts. Additionally, the focus indicator uses a 3px solid outline with a 2px offset, which is generally compliant, but the color contrast against the background must be verified for all interactive states.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The abbreviation 'ORD' in the table cells (e.g., #ORD-001) is used without a definition mechanism (like <abbr title='Order'>) to clarify its meaning for users who may not be familiar with the specific shorthand.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text and paragraphs do not meet the line spacing requirement of at least 1.5. The 'text-sm' and 'text-gray-600' classes typically default to a line-height of 1.25 or 1.375 in many CSS frameworks (like Tailwind), which is below the AAA requirement.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page lacks a mechanism to allow the user to select foreground and background colors, which is a requirement for Success Criterion 1.4.8 at the AAA level.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The 'Recent Orders' table and its sorting/filtering controls lack context-sensitive help or instructions. While labels are present, complex data views at the AAA level should provide help mechanisms or documentation to assist users in understanding how to interact with the data or interpret the status indicators.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The CSS reset or Tailwind base styles are setting 'outline: none' or 'outline: auto' via ':-moz-focusring' and other selectors, while the provided computed styles for interactive elements show 'outline-width: 0px'. Although ':focus-visible' is defined with a 3px outline, many elements (like the 'select' and various 'button' tags) are reported with 0px outlines in their current state, which may fail the 2px thickness requirement for AAA if the focus-visible state is not consistently applied or if it is overridden by the 'outline: none' in the reset.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The '.modal-overlay' uses 'position: fixed' and 'inset: 0'. At the AAA level, if this modal or any fixed element (like a potential sticky header) overlaps any part of a focused element in the background, it is a violation. While the modal is 'display: none' by default, when 'open' it completely obscures all underlying focusable content.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The link text 'Learn More' is ambiguous when taken out of context. Under AAA standards, the link purpose must be identifiable from the link text alone.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text in the hero section and feature cards does not meet the minimum line-height requirement of 1.5. The Tailwind 'text-xl' and 'text-gray-600' classes do not provide sufficient leading for AAA compliance.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page lacks a mechanism to allow users to select foreground and background colors, which is a requirement for AAA visual presentation.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The pricing plan selection buttons and 'Get Started' CTAs initiate a signup/modal process without providing context-sensitive help, instructions, or a help mechanism to assist users in completing the complex task of choosing and configuring a plan.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The focus indicator for interactive elements (links and buttons) is defined using 'outline: 3px solid #1f2937' only on ':focus-visible'. While this provides a 3px perimeter, the provided computed styles for several elements show 'outline: none 0px', suggesting that the default focus indicator is suppressed or not consistently applied across all interactive states, potentially failing the contrast and visibility requirements for AAA.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The header element uses the 'sticky' and 'top-0' classes. At the AAA level, no part of a focused element can be obscured. As a user tabs through the page, the sticky header will overlap and completely obscure focusable elements (like links in the main content) as they scroll behind it.

violations.impact: serious

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The focus indicator for the skip link and several buttons relies on a 3px solid outline with a 2px offset. While the thickness is sufficient, the color #0066cc against the dark header background (#1b2a4a) or white background may not consistently meet the 3:1 contrast ratio against all adjacent colors in all states, particularly for the skip link which appears over the dark header.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The text blocks in the 'hero', 'features', and 'testimonials' sections lack a max-width constraint, which can lead to line lengths exceeding 80 characters on wide viewports.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The 'Full Name' and 'Company Name' fields in the sign-up form lack context-sensitive help. While labels are present, there are no instructions or help mechanisms to assist users in understanding specific requirements or providing examples for these inputs at the AAA level.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The 'Tell us about your team' textarea uses a placeholder for instructions. Placeholders are not a valid substitute for persistent help text as they disappear when the user starts typing, violating the requirement for available context-sensitive help.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The header element is 'position: sticky', which can cause focused elements to be entirely or partially obscured when the page is scrolled, violating the AAA requirement that no part of the focused element be hidden.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The focus indicator for navigation links and form elements relies on a 3px solid outline. While the thickness is sufficient, the color #2563eb (blue) may not provide a 3:1 contrast ratio against the adjacent background colors in all contexts (e.g., when focused over the blue logo or specific button states), and the default focus state for several 'a' tags and 'button' tags in the provided styles shows an outline of 0px or none.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The input elements (text, email, password) use a border-color change on focus without a sufficient focus indicator. violations.impact: moderate

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The text blocks within the dashboard (such as the header description and footer) do not have a mechanism to adjust line spacing or colors, and the provided HTML lacks a max-width constraint on text blocks, potentially allowing lines to exceed 80 characters on wide viewports.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The dashboard contains complex data tables and performance metrics but lacks context-sensitive help, instructions, or a help mechanism to explain the data or how to interact with the sorting/filtering features.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The focus indicator for several interactive elements (specifically the table sort buttons and action buttons) relies on a 2px outline that may not meet the AAA requirement for a 2px thick perimeter around the entire element if the contrast against the background or the element itself is insufficient. Additionally, the default focus state for 'a' tags and some 'button' tags shows 'outline: none' or '0px' in the provided styles, which fails to provide a visible focus indicator.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The '.modal-overlay' uses 'position: fixed' and covers the entire viewport. At the AAA level, if this modal is triggered, it obscures all underlying focusable content. While focus should be trapped within the modal, any elements remaining in the tab order that are covered would violate the 'no part obscured' requirement.

violations.description: The text block in the form introduction and the footer does not have a mechanism to ensure line length is restricted to 80 characters or less, and the line-height is not specified to be at least 1.5 times the font size.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page lacks a mechanism to allow users to select foreground and background colors.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The success message is automatically dismissed after 5 seconds (setTimeout(() => { setSubmitted(false); }, 5000)). At the AAA level, no timing is allowed for non-essential activities, and the user should be able to read the confirmation at their own pace.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The form automatically shifts focus back to the 'Name' input field after a successful submission without a specific user request to restart the form. This unexpected change of context can be disorienting for screen reader users.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The focus indicator for input, select, and textarea elements uses 'outline: none' in the :focus state. While it adds a box-shadow and border-color, the box-shadow (3px rgba(27, 42, 74, 0.2)) does not meet the 3:1 contrast ratio against the background required for the focus appearance area at the AAA level.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The skip-link element does not define a specific focus indicator that meets the 2px thick perimeter or 3:1 contrast requirements against its own background or adjacent colors, relying on default browser outlines which are often insufficient for AAA.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The abbreviations 'GDPR', 'SOC2', and 'HIPAA' are used without a mechanism (such as <abbr title='...'>) to provide their full expansion on first occurrence. These are domain-specific regulatory and compliance terms that may not be understood by a general audience.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The abbreviation 'ROI' (Return on Investment) is used without a mechanism to provide its full expansion. While common in business, it is a domain-specific term that requires definition for AAA compliance.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The main content and text blocks lack a max-width constraint, allowing lines of text to exceed 80 characters depending on the viewport width.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text and paragraph elements do not have a line-height of at least 1.5 specified in the styles, which is required for AAA compliance.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: There is no mechanism provided within the page to allow users to select foreground and background colors.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The sign-up form lacks context-sensitive help. While it provides error messages and labels, it does not provide instructions or help text for complex requirements like the password format (e.g., 'at least 8 characters') before the user submits the form and triggers an error.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The modal automatically closes after a 2-second delay following a successful submission ('setTimeout(() => { onClose(); }, 2000)'). This change of context is not directly initiated by a user action (like clicking a close button) and may disorient users who have not finished reading the success message.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The header element is 'position: sticky', which can fully obscure focused elements as the user scrolls through the page. At the AAA level, no part of the focused element can be obscured.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The input elements (text, email, password, select) have 'outline: none' on focus. While they change border-color, this does not meet the 2px thick perimeter requirement or the contrast requirements for a focus indicator at the AAA level.

violations.impact: moderate

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The abbreviation 'ORD' (Order) is used repeatedly in the table and modal without an <abbr> tag or definition on first occurrence.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The footer text and main content paragraphs do not have a specified line-height of at least 1.5, which is required for visual presentation at the AAA level.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The page lacks a mechanism to allow users to select foreground and background colors, which is a requirement for Success Criterion 1.4.8 at the AAA level.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The table caption and footer text blocks lack explicit max-width constraints to ensure lines do not exceed 80 characters in width.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The dashboard contains complex data (KPIs and a sortable data table) but lacks context-sensitive help, instructions, or a help mechanism to explain the metrics or how to interact with the data table features.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The focus indicator for the skip-link and other interactive elements uses a 3px solid outline with a 2px offset. While the thickness meets the 2px requirement, the contrast ratio of the blue outline (#0d6efd) against the dark header background (#1b2a4a) is approximately 2.1:1, which fails the 3:1 contrast requirement for focus appearance against adjacent colors.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The instruction in the table caption 'Click row action buttons to view details' relies on the visual location/role of the buttons ('action buttons') without providing a specific textual name for the buttons within the instruction, though the buttons themselves have labels. However, in this specific context, the instruction is borderline and generally acceptable as the buttons are named 'Details'.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text and paragraph elements do not have a line-height of at least 1.5 specified in the CSS (Tailwind 'text-gray-600' and 'text-sm' defaults are typically 1.25 or 1.5, but must be explicitly 1.5 within paragraphs).

violations.impact: minor

violations.impact: minor

violations.impact: minor

violations.impact: critical
violations.description: The focus indicators for multiple interactive elements (buttons and links) are reported as having an outline-width of 0px. violations.impact: serious

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The link text 'Learn More' is ambiguous when taken out of context. Under WCAG 2.2 AAA 2.4.9, the purpose of each link must be identifiable from the link text alone.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The main content container (max-w-4xl) and feature descriptions lack a mechanism to ensure line length does not exceed 80 characters. Depending on the viewport and font size, lines in the hero paragraph and testimonials may exceed the 80-character limit.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text and paragraphs do not have a line-height (leading) of at least 1.5 within paragraphs and 2.25 between paragraphs, which is required for AAA compliance.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: There is no mechanism provided for the user to select foreground and background colors for the page content.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The sign-up form lacks context-sensitive help for complex fields. While labels and required indicators are present, there are no instructions or help mechanisms to assist users in understanding specific requirements for the 'Company name' or 'Email address' fields beyond the basic labels.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The focus indicator for several interactive elements (including buttons and links) uses a 3px solid outline but with an outline-offset of 2px. This creates a gap between the element and the indicator, which can fail the 'adjacent colors' contrast requirement if the background color of the page does not provide 3:1 contrast against the outline color (#1f2937). Additionally, the provided computed styles show 'outline: none 0px' for multiple elements, indicating the focus-visible styles may not be applying correctly to all interactive components.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The '.toast-region' is a fixed-position container. At the AAA level, no part of a focused element can be obscured. If a toast notification appears while a user is navigating elements in the bottom-right of the viewport (such as footer links or form fields), the focused element would be partially or fully obscured by the fixed notification.

violations.description: The main body text and paragraphs lack a line-height of at least 1.5. The current style for the dashboard description is set to 0.875rem with no line-height specified, defaulting to browser standard (usually 1.2).

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The text blocks within the table and dashboard cards do not have a mechanism to adjust foreground and background colors, nor is there a max-width constraint on the container-lg to ensure lines do not exceed 80 characters on large viewports.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The dashboard contains complex data (Total Revenue, Conversion Rate, etc.) and a table with various order statuses without context-sensitive help or definitions for the metrics and status types.

violations.impact: serious
violations.description: The main content container has 'outline: none' applied on focus. While it is a container, it is programmatically focusable via 'tabindex="-1"' and the skip link. At AAA level, focusable elements must have a visible focus indicator that meets specific size and contrast requirements.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The focus indicator for buttons and links (3px solid #0d6efd) may not provide a 3:1 contrast ratio against the primary blue background used in the 'skip-link:focus' and 'pagination button[aria-current="page"]' states, as the indicator color is identical to the background color.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The instruction in the table caption 'Click a row or use the Details button' refers to a 'Details' button that does not exist in the table markup. If the user is expected to identify a specific button (such as the status indicators) as the 'Details' button based on its visual appearance or location without a corresponding text label, it violates sensory characteristics.

violations.description: Page provides 0 navigation mechanism(s) (none). WCAG 2.4.5 requires at least 2 ways to locate a page (e.g., navigation menu, search, sitemap, table of contents, breadcrumb).

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The page lacks any landmark roles (such as <main>, <header>, <nav>, or <footer>) to identify the purpose of the content regions.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The body text lacks a mechanism or CSS styling to ensure line spacing (leading) is at least space-and-a-half (1.5) within paragraphs, and paragraph spacing is at least 1.5 times larger than the line spacing.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The text blocks lack a mechanism to ensure width is no more than 80 characters or glyphs (40 if CJK). Without a max-width constraint on the container, text will span the full width of the viewport on large monitors.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The application automatically closes the modal and clears the success message after 3 seconds (setTimeout). At AAA level, no timing is allowed for non-essential activities, and the user should control when the content is dismissed.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The signup form lacks context-sensitive help. While there are error messages, there are no instructions, tooltips, or help links provided to assist the user in completing the form before an error occurs.

violations.impact: moderate
violations.description: The '.toast-container' is position:fixed at the bottom-right. At the AAA level, no part of a focused element can be obscured. If a focusable element (such as a footer link) is located behind this container, it would be obscured when the toast is active.

violations.impact: minor
violations.description: The focus indicator defined in ':focus-visible' uses a color (#0d6efd) against a white background. While this meets contrast, the 'outline-offset: 2px' creates a gap between the element and the indicator. At the AAA level, the focus appearance must ensure the area of the focus indicator is at least as large as a 2px thick perimeter of the unfocused component. A 3px outline with a 2px offset may not meet the area calculation requirements for all element shapes.

violations.description: The link text 'Learn more about performance' is descriptive, but the links 'Explore security features' and 'View dashboard demo' are also descriptive. However, the link 'Learn more about performance' is acceptable, but the generic 'Learn more' or 'Read more' style links are often flagged. In this specific HTML, the links 'Learn more about performance', 'Explore security features', and 'View dashboard demo' are sufficiently descriptive. However, the link 'Sign Up' in the navigation and the 'Get Started Free' button are clear. The only potentially ambiguous links are the 'Learn more...' links if they were just 'Learn more', but here they include context. Therefore, no violation is found for 2.4.9 based on the strict instructions.
